steps: 1. Server component calls https://fantasy.nfl.com/api/token with Cookie header containing NFL SSO + ff cookie copied from DevTools
3. Create API route /api/nfl/proxy that accepts ?url= encoded ffsim URL
4. Forward request with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and same Cookie + Referer headers
6. Client pages call /api/nfl/proxy?url=... instead of ffsim directly to avoid CORS
